segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin says the product was terrible and caused painful breakouts, while another describing herself as oily and acne-prone reports it was the best cleanser she has tried and brought no irritation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cleanser leaves skin moisturized rather than tight or stripped, with one saying past cleansers left her dry within minutes but this one keeps her hydrated all day.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers identifying as sensitive report no irritation, burning, or tightness, including one who pairs sensitive with dry skin and calls it gentle where other cleansers were harsh.
segments.combination: One reviewer states the ingredient combination suits various skin types, though she does not report on her own skin directly.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say the cleanser hydrates and does not leave skin feeling stripped or tight; one with dry skin reports no dryness even 10 minutes after washing, and one with eczema also reports no dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes no burning feeling after use; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe skin as calm, soothed, and not stripped after use, including one who mentions eczema and reports no irritation.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark spots or hyperpigmentation report visible fading or more even tone, some within a week; one reviewer specifically credits it for reducing post-breakout dark marks.
concerns.blemishes: One oily, acne-prone reviewer reports it cleared her breakouts and acne; another reviewer with oily skin reports the opposite, describing painful new breakouts from the product.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer describes the product itself as very oily and unsuitable for her oily skin, while other reviewers do not mention oiliness as an issue.

extraits.texte: I thought the kojic acid and honey combination would be great for my skin. Honey is known for its antibacterial properties, however, the product is very oily and caused me to have painful breakouts! Great if you have dry skin and dark spots. Terrible for acne-prone skin.

extraits.titre: Best cleanser I've ever tried for my skin
extraits.texte: I have oily acne prone skin. I have struggled with adult acne since my 20s. I have tried all the things and eventually got a regimen that kept everything stable. But now in my 30s, my skin has become more sensitive, still breakout prone, and dull/discolored from post inflammatory hyperpigmentation. I stumbled upon Rosen and really connected with the founder as a fellow black woman. I tried this cleanser, spot treatment, and the serum. To say I have been wowed is an understatement. I didn't think possible but my skin has been bumped to the next level. Appeared brighter after a few days of use, more glowy and smooth. Best of all! No irritation! I am so thrilled to continue to support this brand with the amazing results I'm seeing so far. Will continue to repurchase here on out! Go Rosen!

I've been using the ROSEN Honey Kojic Cleanser, and I have to say—this is a game-changer for anyone looking for a gentle yet effective brightening cleanser. The combination of honey and kojic acid makes it a powerhouse for fading dark spots while keeping the skin hydrated. Unlike some kojic-based products that can be drying, this one feels nourishing and soothing, thanks to the honey. The texture is smooth, and it lathers just enough without stripping the skin. After consistent use, I noticed my complexion looking more even and radiant. It's also great for sensitive skin, as it doesn't cause irritation or that tight, dry feeling. If you're looking for a natural, effective cleanser that helps with hyperpigmentation while keeping your skin soft, I'd definitely recommend giving this one a try!
